parent_objective: run retarget proposal generator on M1452 replay rows
blocked_by: retarget generator has not yet been run on public M1452 replay rows

public_gates: M1457 must run retarget proposal generation only
M1457 must not run preflight replay train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1457 must report proposal rows selected retarget rows class counts and diversity

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs proposal generator on M1452 replay rows before preflight or replay rerun
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: proposal-generation smoke only; no preflight, replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if candidate_step_column is not source_step
stop if selected diversity collapses to one seed or one class
stop if run starts preflight replay or training
fallback_plan: route to retarget proposal audit if selected rows are sparse
route to source-step retarget preflight design if proposal gates pass

admission_evidence: M1456 implementation and focused tests passed
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up preflight design or audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: proposal counts and class counts are recorded

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1457 is proposal generation and makes no history-necessity claim.
history_necessity_tests: future retargeted preflight/replay must test normal history against history interventions
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If proposal generation is sparse, audit proposal logic rather than lowering replay standards.
allowed_claims: no replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1456 retarget generator can produce a diverse source-step retarget candidate pool from M1452 replay diagnostics.
failure_criteria: run starts preflight replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1457 passes if retarget proposal generation produces diverse source-step candidates without preflight or replay.
